results.title: AI-assisted tool helps secure satellite communications after Russia’s 2022 hack
results.description: An AI-assisted cybersecurity tool used to secure Viasat after Russia's 2022 satellite hack has been released commercially, as threats to critical infrastructure from state-backed hackers grow.

results.title: Abu Dhabi congress to explore Arabic AI tools and creative industries financing
results.description: The fifth Congress of Arabic and Creative Industries takes place September 20 in Abu Dhabi, focusing on growing the sector globally. The free event, organized by the Abu Dhabi Arabic Language Centre, covers AI tools, licensing, and investment gaps in MENA's creative economy.
